steps.name: Build AppImage
steps.run:
# Find the Linux binary from goreleaser output
BINARY=$(find dist/ -name "cluckers" -path "*cluckers-linux*" -not -path "*/cluckers.exe" -type f | head -1)
if [ -z "$BINARY" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Could not find Linux binary in dist/"
  find dist/ -type f -name "cluckers*"
  exit 1

cd ..

gh release upload "$TAG_NAME" \
  dist/Cluckers-x86_64.AppImage \
  dist/Cluckers-x86_64.AppImage.zsync \
  dist/checksums.txt \
  --clobber

  --candidates "${{ steps.agg.outputs.candidate_modules }}" \
  --rerun "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/behavioral-rerun.json"

steps.name: Decide
steps.run:
newly='${{ steps.confirm.outputs.newly_failing }}'
newly_count='${{ steps.confirm.outputs.newly_failing_count }}'
[[ -z "$newly_count" ]] && newly_count=0
collab_vacuous='${{ steps.agg.outputs.collab_vacuous }}'

scream=false
rollback=false
if [[ "$newly_count" -gt 0 ]]; then
  scream=true
  # Auto-rollback ONLY for a reproduced behavioral regression (a code
  # break tied to this push's SHA), never for collab vacuity.
  if [[ "$AUTO_ROLLBACK" == "1" ]]; then rollback=true; fi
fi
if [[ "$collab_vacuous" == "true" ]]; then scream=true; fi

{
  echo "scream=$scream"
  echo "rollback=$rollback"
  echo "newly_failing=$newly"
  echo "newly_count=$newly_count"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "scream=$scream rollback=$rollback newly='$newly' collab_vacuous=$collab_vacuous"

steps.name: Open rollback PR (optional, never auto-merged)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
SHA='${{ github.sha }}'
SHORT="${SHA:0:12}"
BRANCH="rollback/behavioral-${SHORT}"
git config user.name  "behavioral-watchdog[bot]"
git config user.email "behavioral-watchdog@users.noreply.github.com"
git checkout -b "$BRANCH"
# Prefer the merge-commit revert; fall back to a plain revert if the
# pushed commit is not a merge (squash-merge → single parent).
if ! git revert --no-edit -m 1 "$SHA" 2>/dev/null; then
  git revert --abort 2>/dev/null || true
  git revert --no-edit "$SHA"
fi
git push origin "$BRANCH"
gh pr create --base main --head "$BRANCH" \
  --title "rollback: revert ${SHORT} — reproduced behavioral regression (${NEWLY})" \
  --body "Auto-opened by the behavioral-watchdog (AUTO_ROLLBACK=1) after a REPRODUCED behavioral regression on a push to main (modules: ${NEWLY}). This is a **draft rollback for a human to review + merge** — it is NEVER auto-merged. Close it if the break is being fixed forward instead." \
  --label "p0,behavioral-regression,main-red" \
  --draft

steps.run:

  --behavioral "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/behavioral-report.json" \
  --out ./behavioral-last-green.json \
  --sha '${{ github.sha }}'

steps.name: Fail the run on a reproduced break / vacuous collab
steps.run:
echo "::error::behavioral-watchdog tripped — newly-failing: '${{ steps.decide.outputs.newly_failing }}', collab_vacuous: ${{ steps.agg.outputs.collab_vacuous }}"
exit 1

steps.name: Aggregate result
steps.run:
echo "actionlint:    $ACTIONLINT"
echo "typecheck:     $TYPECHECK"
echo "unit:          $UNIT"
echo "dsp-build:     $DSP_BUILD"
echo "build-web:     $BUILD_WEB"
echo "art:           $ART"
echo "build:         $BUILD"
echo "e2e:           $E2E"
echo "webgl-smoke:   $WEBGL_SMOKE"
echo "webgl-attest:  $WEBGL_ATTEST"
echo "collab-attest: $COLLAB_ATTEST"
echo "grand-attest:  $GRAND_ATTEST (informational — not gating yet)"
echo "behavioral-smoke: $BEHAVIORAL_SMOKE"
echo "collab:        (informational — see collab job; temporarily un-gated, task #69)"
# `e2e` is a matrix; its aggregated result is `success` only if all
# shards succeeded. (The old `e2e-video` WebGL-heavy lane was deleted
# 2026-06-20 — it had been dormant/dispatch-only; webgl-smoke +
# webgl-attest are the heavy-WebGL gates now.) `collab` is
# TEMPORARILY UN-GATED (informational — pending the 5x
# collab-flake-purge; see the needs: note above). It is deliberately
# NOT in the failing condition below. `behavioral` is
# INFORMATIONAL again — gating it on a single clean run (#562) was
# premature; it flaked on moog911 on the very next PR. Re-gate only
# after a proper 3x flake-purge. `merge-reports` also stays OUT.
#
# `build` is the PRODUCTION-bundle gate (`task build` = dsp:build +
# `vite build`). It's gated here so a broken prod bundle fails this
# already-required umbrella → blocks merge with no ruleset change.
# This closes the Clerk #464 gap where a broken bundle merged because
# no required check ran the production bundler.
#
# `dsp-build` compiles the Faust worklets ONCE and is a dependency of
# art/build/build-web/e2e/collab (+ vrt/behavioral). A failure there
# cascades to those jobs, but we gate on it explicitly so a broken DSP
# compile produces a clear, fast failure signal instead of a wall of
# confusing "artifact not found" downloads.
#
# `build-web` builds the Vite/SvelteKit preview bundle ONCE; the 8
# e2e shards download it and run against `vite preview`. It's gated
# here so a broken web build (or a missing test-hooks bundle) fails
# this umbrella → the e2e shards would otherwise fail confusingly on
# an "artifact not found" download.
#
# `behavioral-coverage` (BEHAVIORAL) is INFORMATIONAL
# (continue-on-error; push/label-only) and is deliberately NOT in this
# gate — the 1x gate (#562) flaked on moog911 on the next PR, so it is
# un-gated pending a proper 3x flake-purge. `merge-reports` is likewise
# informational and left out of this gate.
# $GRAND_ATTEST is INFORMATIONAL-first (2026-07-19): the grand-integration
# local-GPU attest verify is new test infra; it sits in `needs:`+`env:`
# (umbrella waits + logs it) but is deliberately NOT in the failing test
# below, exactly how webgl-attest + collab-attest started. Arm it required
# later by adding `|| "$GRAND_ATTEST" != "success"` here once the pin is
# stable. See ci-grand-attest/README.md.
if [[ "$ACTIONLINT" != "success" \
   || "$TYPECHECK" != "success" \
   || "$UNIT" != "success" \
   || "$DSP_BUILD" != "success" \
   || "$BUILD_WEB" != "success" \
   || "$ART" != "success" \
   || "$BUILD" != "success" \
   || "$E2E" != "success" \

steps.name: Resolve Version
steps.run:
# 确定版本号和发布类型
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
  INPUT_VERSION="${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
  RELEASE_TYPE="${{ github.event.inputs.release_type }}"
else
  if echo "${{ github.ref }}" | grep -q "^refs/tags/"; then
    INPUT_VERSION=$(echo "${{ github.ref }}" | sed 's/refs\/tags\///')
  else
    INPUT_VERSION="auto"
  fi
  RELEASE_TYPE="最新正式版（latest release）"
fi

# 如果为 auto 或空，优先检查当前 checkout 的 commit 是否有对应的 git tag
if [ "$INPUT_VERSION" = "auto" ] || [ -z "$INPUT_VERSION" ]; then
  CURRENT_COMMIT_TAG=$(git describe --tags --exact-match HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  if [ -n "$CURRENT_COMMIT_TAG" ]; then
    VERSION=$(echo "$CURRENT_COMMIT_TAG" | sed 's/^v//' | tr -d '[:space:]')
    SOURCE="git tag of checkout"
  elif [ -f VERSION ]; then
    VERSION=$(cat VERSION | tr -d '[:space:]')
    SOURCE="VERSION file"
  else
    VERSION=$(grep -oP 'Version\s*=\s*"\K[^"]+' main.go || echo "1.1.2")
    SOURCE="main.go"
  fi
else
  VERSION=$(echo "$INPUT_VERSION" | sed 's/^v//' | tr -d '[:space:]')
  SOURCE="workflow input"
fi

echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "release_type=$RELEASE_TYPE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "VERSION=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV
echo "RELEASE_TYPE=$RELEASE_TYPE" >> $GITHUB_ENV

# 获取实际的 commit hash 并存入 outputs 与 ENV
COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo "commit_hash=$COMMIT_HASH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "COMMIT_HASH=$COMMIT_HASH" >> $GITHUB_ENV

# 更新 VERSION 文件确保一致性
echo "$VERSION" > VERSION

echo "📦 当前版本号: $VERSION (来源: $SOURCE)"
echo "📦 发布类型: $RELEASE_TYPE"
echo "📦 实际 Commit: $COMMIT_HASH"

steps.name: Generate Custom Changelog
steps.run:
import os
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta

version = os.environ.get('VERSION', '0.0.0')
release_type = os.environ.get('RELEASE_TYPE', '最新正式版（latest release）')
repo = os.environ.get('GITHUB_REPOSITORY', '')

# 获取 commit hash
commit_hash = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).decode('utf-8').strip()

# 寻找上一个 tag (排除了刚刚创建的当前 tag)
try:
    prev_tag = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'describe', '--tags', '--abbrev=0', 'HEAD^'], stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).decode('utf-8').strip()
except Exception:
    prev_tag = ''

# 获取提交日志
git_log_cmd = ['git', 'log', '--format=%s']
if prev_tag:
    git_log_cmd.append(f'{prev_tag}..HEAD')

try:
    commits = subprocess.check_output(git_log_cmd).decode('utf-8').strip().split('\n')
    commits = [c.strip() for c in commits if c.strip()]
except Exception:
    commits = []

features = []
improvements = []
bugs = []

for msg in commits:
    # 忽略临时提交和合并分支提交
    if msg.startswith('temp:') or msg.startswith('Merge branch'):
        continue
    msg_lower = msg.lower()
    if msg_lower.startswith('feat') or '✨' in msg:
        features.append(f"- {msg}")
    elif msg_lower.startswith('fix') or msg_lower.startswith('bug') or '🐞' in msg:
        bugs.append(f"- {msg}")
    elif any(msg_lower.startswith(x) for x in ['refactor', 'perf', 'style', 'clean', 'optimize', 'enhance']) or '💫' in msg:
        improvements.append(f"- {msg}")
    else:
        improvements.append(f"- {msg}")

# 上海时间 (UTC+8)
tz_shanghai = timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
build_time_str = datetime.now(tz_shanghai).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

body = []
body.append("## 版本信息")
body.append(f"- **版本**: v{version}")
body.append(f"- **Commit**: {commit_hash}")
body.append(f"- **构建时间**: {build_time_str} (北京时间)")
body.append(f"- **发布类型**: {release_type}")
body.append("")

body.append("## 更新记录")
if features:
    body.append("**✨ 新增功能**")
    body.extend(features)
    body.append("")
if improvements:
    body.append("**💫 体验优化**")
    body.extend(improvements)
    body.append("")
if bugs:
    body.append("**🐞 bug 修复**")
    body.extend(bugs)
    body.append("")

if prev_tag:
    body.append(f"**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/{repo}/compare/{prev_tag}...v{version}")

# 写到临时目录，防止影响 git 状态导致 GoReleaser 报 dirty 错
runner_temp = os.environ.get('RUNNER_TEMP', '.')
notes_path = os.path.join(runner_temp, 'release_notes.md')
with open(notes_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write('\n'.join(body))

steps.name: Publish GitHub release
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cd target/distrib
# Require the full asset set so a partial build never publishes a
# half-populated release. Four targets x (archive + checksum) + installer.
assets=""
for t in x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
         x86_64-apple-darwin aarch64-apple-darwin; do
  for f in "iris-agent-$t.tar.gz" "iris-agent-$t.tar.gz.sha256"; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "missing release asset: $f" >&2; exit 1; }
    assets="$assets $f"
  done
done
[ -f iris-agent-installer.sh ] || { echo "missing installer" >&2; exit 1; }
assets="$assets iris-agent-installer.sh"
# A tag with a prerelease component (v0.3.0-rc.1) is a testing
# channel: mark the release object prerelease so it never becomes
# `releases/latest` — install.sh and `iris update` resolve latest, so
# users can never be handed a testing build (`decide_update` also
# refuses prerelease tags as a second, client-side gate).
prerelease=""
case "$TAG" in
  *-*) prerelease="--prerelease" ;;
esac
# Idempotent so the job can be re-run: create the release only if it is
# absent, then upload assets with --clobber to replace any partial ones.
# Created as a draft and published only after every asset is attached:
# a draft is invisible to `releases/latest`, so an install or update
# can never resolve a release whose archives are still uploading.
if ! gh release view "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
  gh release create "$TAG" --draft $prerelease --title "Iris $TAG" --generate-notes
fi
# shellcheck disable=SC2086
gh release upload "$TAG" --clobber $assets
gh release edit "$TAG" --draft=false

steps.name: Build demos for all platforms
steps.run:

# windows has no arm64 (mirrors goreleaser.yaml)

      go mod tidy && \

steps.name: core must not depend on rmcp
steps.run:
# Write to a file first: piping straight into grep makes a `cargo tree`
# failure indistinguishable from "no rmcp found", so the gate would
# silently pass when the tool itself broke. Keep the file under
# $RUNNER_TEMP so a local run doesn't litter the repo root.
tree_file="$RUNNER_TEMP/core-tree.txt"
cargo tree -p compact-mcp-core --prefix none > "$tree_file"
if grep -qx 'rmcp v.*' "$tree_file"; then
  echo "::error::compact-mcp-core must not depend on rmcp"; exit 1
fi

# or compromised release can no longer silently change what executes in

curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf "$url" -o "$installer"

sh "$installer"

# Iterate over released packages and add a label to the PRs
# shipped with the release.
for release in $(echo "$RELEASES" | jq -r -c '.[]'); do
    package_name=$(echo "$release" | jq -r '.package_name')
    version=$(echo "$release" | jq -r '.version')
    prs_length=$(echo "$release" | jq '.prs | length')
    if [ "$prs_length" -gt 0 ]; then
        # Create label.
        # Use `--force` to overwrite the label,
        # so that the command does not fail if the label already exists.
        label="released:$package_name-$version"
        echo "Creating label $label"
        gh label create $label --color BFD4F2 --force
        for pr in $(echo "$release" | jq -r -c '.prs[]'); do
            pr_number=$(echo "$pr" | jq -r '.number')
            echo "Adding label $label to PR #$pr_number"
            gh pr edit $pr_number --add-label $label
        done
    else

  else

steps.name: Validate platform binaries
steps.run:
declare -A PLATFORM_PKG_DIRS=(
  ["darwin-arm64"]="packages/cli-darwin-arm64"
  ["darwin-x64"]="packages/cli-darwin-x64"
  ["linux-x64"]="packages/cli-linux-x64-gnu"
  ["linux-arm64"]="packages/cli-linux-arm64-gnu"
  ["win32-x64"]="packages/cli-win32-x64"
  ["win32-arm64"]="packages/cli-win32-arm64"
)
min_size=100000
failures=0

for suffix in "${!PLATFORM_PKG_DIRS[@]}"; do
  package_dir="${PLATFORM_PKG_DIRS[$suffix]}"

  if [[ "$suffix" == win32-* ]]; then
    binary_path="${package_dir}/bin/actionbook.exe"
  else
    binary_path="${package_dir}/bin/actionbook"
  fi

  if [[ ! -f "${binary_path}" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Missing binary ${binary_path}"
    failures=$((failures + 1))
    continue
  fi

  size=$(stat -c%s "${binary_path}")
  if [[ "$size" -lt "$min_size" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Binary too small ${binary_path} (${size} bytes)"
    failures=$((failures + 1))
    continue
  fi

  echo "OK: ${binary_path} (${size} bytes)"
done

if [[ "$failures" -gt 0 ]]; then
  echo "Found ${failures} platform binary validation errors"
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Generate SHA256 checksums for CLI binaries
steps.run:
EXPECTED_ASSETS=(
  "actionbook-darwin-arm64"
  "actionbook-darwin-x64"
  "actionbook-linux-x64"
  "actionbook-linux-arm64"
  "actionbook-win32-x64.exe"
  "actionbook-win32-arm64.exe"
)

missing=0
for asset in "${EXPECTED_ASSETS[@]}"; do
  artifact_dir="${asset%.exe}"
  binary_path="artifacts/${artifact_dir}/${asset}"
  if [[ ! -f "$binary_path" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Expected binary not found: $binary_path"
    missing=$((missing + 1))
  fi
done
if [[ "$missing" -gt 0 ]]; then
  echo "Missing $missing expected binaries — aborting checksum generation"
  exit 1
fi

mkdir -p artifacts/checksums
: > artifacts/checksums/SHA256SUMS
for asset in "${EXPECTED_ASSETS[@]}"; do
  artifact_dir="${asset%.exe}"
  binary_path="artifacts/${artifact_dir}/${asset}"
  checksum=$(sha256sum "$binary_path" | awk '{print $1}')
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$checksum" "$asset" >> artifacts/checksums/SHA256SUMS
done

echo "--- SHA256SUMS ---"
cat artifacts/checksums/SHA256SUMS

steps.name: Update Homebrew formula
steps.run:
VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
TAG="actionbook-cli-v${VERSION}"

# Read SHA256SUMS generated earlier in this job
CHECKSUMS_FILE="artifacts/checksums/SHA256SUMS"
if [[ ! -f "$CHECKSUMS_FILE" ]]; then
  echo "WARNING: SHA256SUMS not found, skipping Homebrew formula update"
  exit 0
fi

get_sha() {
  local asset="$1"
  grep "  ${asset}$" "$CHECKSUMS_FILE" | cut -d' ' -f1
}

SHA_DARWIN_ARM64=$(get_sha "actionbook-darwin-arm64")
SHA_DARWIN_X64=$(get_sha "actionbook-darwin-x64")
SHA_LINUX_ARM64=$(get_sha "actionbook-linux-arm64")
SHA_LINUX_X64=$(get_sha "actionbook-linux-x64")

# Generate the updated formula
cat > /tmp/actionbook.rb << RUBY_EOF
# typed: false
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Formula auto-updated by actionbook/actionbook release CI.
# Manual edits will be overwritten on the next release.
class Actionbook < Formula
  desc "CLI for Actionbook - run AI actions from your terminal"
  homepage "https://actionbook.dev"
  version "${VERSION}"
  license "MIT"

  on_macos do
    if Hardware::CPU.arm?
      url "https://github.com/actionbook/actionbook/releases/download/${TAG}/actionbook-darwin-arm64"
      sha256 "${SHA_DARWIN_ARM64}"
    else
      url "https://github.com/actionbook/actionbook/releases/download/${TAG}/actionbook-darwin-x64"
      sha256 "${SHA_DARWIN_X64}"
    end
  end

  on_linux do
    if Hardware::CPU.arm?
      url "https://github.com/actionbook/actionbook/releases/download/${TAG}/actionbook-linux-arm64"
      sha256 "${SHA_LINUX_ARM64}"
    else
      url "https://github.com/actionbook/actionbook/releases/download/${TAG}/actionbook-linux-x64"
      sha256 "${SHA_LINUX_X64}"
    end
  end

  def install
    binary_name = "actionbook"
    if OS.mac?
      bin.install (Hardware::CPU.arm? ? "actionbook-darwin-arm64" : "actionbook-darwin-x64") => binary_name
    else
      bin.install (Hardware::CPU.arm? ? "actionbook-linux-arm64" : "actionbook-linux-x64") => binary_name
    end
  end

  test do
    assert_match version.to_s, shell_output("#{bin}/actionbook --version")
  end
end
RUBY_EOF

# Remove leading whitespace (heredoc indentation)
sed -i "s/^          //" /tmp/actionbook.rb

# Push to homebrew-tap repo
cd "$(mktemp -d)"
git clone "https://x-access-token:${HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN}@github.com/actionbook/homebrew-tap.git" .

steps.run:

ARTIFACTS='${{ steps.goreleaser.outputs.artifacts }}'

# Extract the first Docker image name (without tag) and its digest
# The image name format is: registry/image:tag or image:tag
# We need: registry/image (with docker.io as default if no registry)

# Get unique image digests (all tags point to same digest)
DIGEST=$(echo "$ARTIFACTS" | jq -r '[.[] | select(.type == "Docker Image")] | .[0].extra.Digest')

# Get image name from first Docker image, strip the tag
FULL_IMAGE=$(echo "$ARTIFACTS" | jq -r '[.[] | select(.type == "Docker Image")] | .[0].name')

# Remove tag (everything after last colon)
IMAGE_NAME="${FULL_IMAGE%:*}"

# If no registry (no slash before image name), prepend docker.io
if [[ "$IMAGE_NAME" != *"/"* ]]; then
  IMAGE_NAME="docker.io/$IMAGE_NAME"
elif [[ "$IMAGE_NAME" != *"."* ]]; then
  # Has slash but no dot in registry part = Docker Hub user/image
  IMAGE_NAME="docker.io/$IMAGE_NAME"
fi

echo "image-name=$IMAGE_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "digest=$DIGEST" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "Docker image for attestation: $IMAGE_NAME@$DIGEST"

steps.name: Create Release Pull Request or Publish to npm
Get pending PRs
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
pending_prs=$(gh pr list --repo "$REPO" --label "autorelease: pending" --state open --json number --jq '.[].number')
need_rebase=""

if [[ -n "$pending_prs" ]]; then
    for pr_num in $pending_prs; do
        echo "Checking pr: $pr_num"
        mergeable=$(gh pr view --repo "$REPO" "$pr_num" --json mergeable --jq '.mergeable')
        echo "mergeable status: $mergeable"
        if [[ "$mergeable" != "MERGEABLE" ]]; then
            echo "pr: $pr_num is not MERGEABLE."
            echo "removing 'autorelease: pending' label from pr: $pr_num"
            gh pr edit --repo "$REPO" "$pr_num" --remove-label "autorelease: pending"
            need_rebase=true
        fi
    done
else
    echo "No pending PRs found."
    exit 0
fi

if [[ -n "$need_rebase" ]]; then
    echo "not MERGEABLE status PRs found."
    echo "need_rebase=$need_rebase"
    echo "need_rebase=$need_rebase" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
    echo "All pending PRs are MERGEABLE."
fi

ANNOUNCEMENT_TITLE=$(jq --raw-output ".announcement_title" dist-manifest.json)
IS_PRERELEASE=$(jq --raw-output ".announcement_is_prerelease" dist-manifest.json)
jq --raw-output ".announcement_github_body" dist-manifest.json > new_dist_announcement.md

echo "created announcement!"
echo "is-prerelease=$IS_PRERELEASE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

# Upload the manifest to the Github Release™
gh release upload ${{ github.ref_name }} dist-manifest.json
echo "uploaded manifest!"

# Disable all the upload-artifacts tasks if we have no actual releases
HAS_RELEASES=$(jq --raw-output ".releases != null" dist-manifest.json)
echo "has-releases=$HAS_RELEASES" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

create-github-release.description: Boolean flag that determines whether to create a GitHub release. If the specified `tag` does not exist, it will be created.

release-variant.description:

If not specified, uses the default values for both.

version-validation-name.description: '(Optional) The name of the extension. Required if any regex patterns use a template that depends on the extension name. (ex: Lifecycle).'

version-validation-paths.description:
A comma-separated list of absolute and/or relative file paths to validate. 
Each path can optionally specify a pattern type using the syntax:

**Syntax:** `path[:file_type]`

**Example:**
`"code/edge/src/main/java/com/adobe/marketing/mobile/EdgeConstants.java, code/gradle.properties"`

version-validation-dependencies.description:
A comma-separated list of dependencies with their versions. 
Each dependency can optionally specify a semicolon-separated list of the file paths where it applies using the `@` symbol.

**Syntax:** `<name> <version>[@file_path1[:pattern_type][;file_path2[:pattern_type];...]]`

- If the `@` syntax is used, the paths provided in the `-p` argument will be overridden, and the dependency will only be applied to the specified files.
- When specifying custom file paths, you must provide either an absolute or relative path to each file.
- If a dependency is missing a version, it will be skipped.
- `<name>` does not have to be regex-escaped, this is handled automatically.

**Example:**
`"Core 7.8.9, EdgeIdentity 8.9.10@code/gradle.properties;code/Constants.kt:test_version"`

steps.name: Stage artifacts
steps.run:
mkdir -p staging
for f in target/dist/*; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  # Preserve compound extensions (.tar.gz) so the artifact isn't named "...-linux-x64.gz".
  case "$f" in
    *.tar.gz) ext="tar.gz" ;;
    *)        ext="${f##*.}" ;;
  esac
  # Linux ARM ships only the tarball (+ jar) — drop the .deb/.rpm installers that -Pdist
  # produced (the .AppImage was skipped upstream).
  if [ "${{ matrix.target }}" = "linux-arm64" ]; then
    case "$ext" in
      deb|rpm|AppImage) continue ;;
    esac
  fi
  cp "$f" "staging/Editora-${VERSION}-${{ matrix.target }}.${ext}"
done
# The fat jar isn't built for macOS (see the -Pfatjar step's condition), so guard the copy.
# The `|| true` is required: GitHub's `shell: bash` runs with `set -eo pipefail`, so a no-match
# `ls` (macOS: no jar) would abort the whole step before the `-n` guard below could skip it.
jar="$(ls target/Editora-*.jar 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)"
if [ -n "$jar" ]; then

fi
echo "version=$v" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Bump pom to the next -SNAPSHOT
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
released="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
current="$(grep -m1 '<version>' pom.xml | sed -E 's/.*<version>(.+)<\/version>.*/\1/')"

# Idempotence guard: only advance when master still sits on the version we just released.
# Anything else (already a -SNAPSHOT, or moved on) means a human got there first — leave it.
if [ "$current" != "$released" ]; then
  echo "master pom is '$current', not the released '$released' — nothing to bump."
  exit 0
fi

# Next patch. A released version is always plain X.Y.Z here (the tag drives it).
IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$released"
next="${major}.${minor}.$((patch + 1))-SNAPSHOT"

# Replace only the FIRST <version> — the project's own, before any dependency/plugin ones.
sed -i -E "0,/<version>${released}<\/version>/s//<version>${next}<\/version>/" pom.xml
grep -m1 '<version>' pom.xml

git config user.name  'github-actions[bot]'
git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'

git commit -m "chore: reopen master at ${next} after ${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
git push origin HEAD:master

steps.name: Verify nested go.mod files match root
steps.run:
ROOT=$(awk '$1=="go"{print $2; exit}' go.mod)
if [ -z "$ROOT" ]; then
  echo "::error::failed to parse go directive from root go.mod"
  exit 1
fi
echo "Root Go version: $ROOT"
status=0
while IFS= read -r mod; do
  ver=$(awk '$1=="go"{print $2; exit}' "$mod")
  if [ "$ver" != "$ROOT" ]; then
    echo "::error file=$mod::go directive $ver does not match root $ROOT"
    status=1
  else
    echo "ok: $mod -> $ver"
  fi
done < <(find . -name go.mod -not -path './go.mod' -not -path './web/themes/*' -not -path './vendor/*')
exit $status

steps.name: Parse test results
steps.run:
echo "## Kotlin SDK Test Results Summary"
echo ""

total_tests=0
total_failures=0
total_errors=0

for module in core client tools; do
  xml_dir="$module/build/test-results/jvmTest"

  if [ -d "$xml_dir" ]; then
    # Sum up test counts from all XML files in the directory
    module_tests=$(find "$xml_dir" -name "*.xml" -exec grep -h '<testsuite' {} \; | grep -o 'tests="[0-9]*"' | sed 's/tests="\([0-9]*\)"/\1/' | awk '{sum += $1} END {print sum}')
    module_failures=$(find "$xml_dir" -name "*.xml" -exec grep -h '<testsuite' {} \; | grep -o 'failures="[0-9]*"' | sed 's/failures="\([0-9]*\)"/\1/' | awk '{sum += $1} END {print sum}')
    module_errors=$(find "$xml_dir" -name "*.xml" -exec grep -h '<testsuite' {} \; | grep -o 'errors="[0-9]*"' | sed 's/errors="\([0-9]*\)"/\1/' | awk '{sum += $1} END {print sum}')

    # Default to 0 if empty
    module_tests=${module_tests:-0}
    module_failures=${module_failures:-0}
    module_errors=${module_errors:-0}

    if [ "$module_tests" -gt 0 ]; then
      echo "✅ kotlin-$module: $module_tests tests, $module_failures failures, $module_errors errors"
      total_tests=$((total_tests + module_tests))
      total_failures=$((total_failures + module_failures))
      total_errors=$((total_errors + module_errors))
    fi
  fi
done

echo ""

steps.name: Determine mode and scope

MODE="${INPUT_MODE:-stable}"
SCOPE="${INPUT_SCOPE:-}"
{

steps.name: Detect TypeScript version changes vs npm
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Fail loud if the detect script itself errors. Previously this used
# `|| echo "[]"` which converted a SCRIPT failure (registry down,
# parser bug, jq missing, etc.) into "nothing to publish" — a release
# could silently no-op. Capture the script's exit code explicitly and
# surface its log on failure. An empty array from a SUCCESSFUL run is
# still valid and routes through the "nothing to publish" branch.
set +e
CHANGED=$(bash scripts/release/detect-ts-version-changes.sh 2>detect-ts.log)
RC=$?
set -e
if [ "$RC" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "::error::detect-ts-version-changes.sh exited with status $RC"
  echo "::group::detect-ts.log"
  cat detect-ts.log || true
  echo "::endgroup::"
  exit 1
fi
cat detect-ts.log || true
[ -z "$CHANGED" ] && CHANGED="[]"
[ "$CHANGED" = "null" ] && CHANGED="[]"
# Validate that the script's stdout parses as JSON. Without this, a
# script that prints diagnostic text to stdout would flow into
# downstream `jq` calls and fail with confusing parse errors far from
# the source.
if ! echo "$CHANGED" | jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "::error::detect-ts-version-changes.sh produced non-JSON stdout"
  echo "::group::stdout (first 200 chars)"
  printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED" | head -c 200
  echo
  echo "::endgroup::"
  exit 1
fi
echo "packages=$CHANGED" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
COUNT=$(echo "$CHANGED" | jq 'length')
echo "count=$COUNT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  PKG_PATH=$(jq -r --arg n "$PROJECT" '.[] | select(.name == $n) | .path' /tmp/ts-packages.json)

  if [ ! -f "${PKG_PATH}/package.json" ]; then
    echo "::error::Missing package.json at ${PKG_PATH} for ${PROJECT}"
    MISMATCH="${MISMATCH} ${PROJECT}"
    continue
  fi
  ACTUAL=$(jq -r '.version' "${PKG_PATH}/package.json")
  if [ "$ACTUAL" != "$EXPECTED" ]; then
    echo "::error::Canary version not restored for ${PROJECT}: on-disk=${ACTUAL}, expected=${EXPECTED}"
    echo "::error::The build job's upload-artifact step must include ${PKG_PATH}/package.json in its path list."
    MISMATCH="${MISMATCH} ${PROJECT}"
  else
    echo "OK: ${PROJECT}@${EXPECTED} restored at ${PKG_PATH}"
  fi
done
if [ -n "$MISMATCH" ]; then
  echo "::error::Canary version restore check failed for:${MISMATCH}"

fi

steps.name: Verify NuGet packages are visible
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

MAX_WAIT_SECONDS=900
SLEEP_SECONDS=15
START_SECONDS=$(date +%s)
MISSING_PACKAGES=$(mktemp)
jq -c '.[]' dotnet-packages.json > "$MISSING_PACKAGES"

while true; do
  NEXT_MISSING=$(mktemp)

  while read -r pkg; do
    NAME=$(echo "$pkg" | jq -r '.name')
    VERSION=$(echo "$pkg" | jq -r '.version')
    LOWER_NAME=$(printf '%s' "$NAME" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
    LOWER_VERSION=$(printf '%s' "$VERSION" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
    URL="https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/${LOWER_NAME}/${LOWER_VERSION}/${LOWER_NAME}.${LOWER_VERSION}.nupkg"

    if curl -fsSL -o /dev/null "$URL" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "::notice::PUBLISHED: ${NAME}@${VERSION}"
    else
      echo "$pkg" >> "$NEXT_MISSING"
    fi
  done < "$MISSING_PACKAGES"

  if [ ! -s "$NEXT_MISSING" ]; then
    rm -f "$MISSING_PACKAGES" "$NEXT_MISSING"
    break
  fi

  NOW_SECONDS=$(date +%s)
  ELAPSED_SECONDS=$((NOW_SECONDS - START_SECONDS))
  if [ "$ELAPSED_SECONDS" -ge "$MAX_WAIT_SECONDS" ]; then
    echo "::error::NuGet verification timed out after ${ELAPSED_SECONDS}s waiting for:"
    jq -r '. | "- \(.name)@\(.version)"' "$NEXT_MISSING"
    exit 1
  fi

  REMAINING_COUNT=$(wc -l < "$NEXT_MISSING" | tr -d ' ')
  echo "::notice::Waiting for ${REMAINING_COUNT} NuGet package(s) to become visible after ${ELAPSED_SECONDS}s"
  mv "$NEXT_MISSING" "$MISSING_PACKAGES"
  sleep "$SLEEP_SECONDS"
done

# Instead capture the exit code: retry a transient failure, and if it still can't
# be determined, FAIL the job (a blocked winget submit is safe + recoverable; a
# duplicate PR to Microsoft is not). Only a CLEAN "version not present" submits.
# (agentjp.bdinfo-rs has existed in winget-pkgs since the 1.0.0 hand-bootstrap, so
# a real success always lists >=1 version — the "package does not exist" error,
# which is also exit 1, cannot legitimately occur here.)
versions=""; ok=0
for attempt in 1 2 3; do
  if versions=$(komac list-versions agentjp.bdinfo-rs 2>/dev/null); then ok=1; break; fi
  echo "komac list-versions failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying..." >&2
  sleep 5
done
if [ "$ok" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "::error::komac list-versions could not determine existing winget-pkgs versions (invalid WINGET_TOKEN or GitHub API error) — refusing to --submit, which could open a duplicate PR. Re-run once resolved, or submit by hand with komac." >&2
  exit 1
fi
if printf '%s\n' "$versions" | sed 's/[[:space:]]//g' | grep -qxF "$ver"; then
  echo "agentjp.bdinfo-rs ${ver} already in winget-pkgs — skipping submit"
else
  # Both windows-msvc .zip archives (x64 + arm64); komac reads the arch from
  # each. --submit opens the version-bump PR against microsoft/winget-pkgs.
  komac update agentjp.bdinfo-rs \
    --version "$ver" \
    --submit \
    --urls \
      "${base}/bdinfo-rs-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip" \
      "${base}/bdinfo-rs-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc.zip"
fi

bdinfo-rs --version

steps.name: Publish the .deb to Cloudsmith
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
pipx install cloudsmith-cli==1.19.0 >/dev/null
ver="${VERSION#v}"
repo=bdinfo-rs/bdinfo-rs
file="dl/bdinfo-rs-${{ matrix.triple }}.deb"
# Cloudsmith stores the packaging-revisioned version (e.g. 1.2.0-1), so a bare
# `version:${ver}` matches NOTHING. Query the anonymous public API by the exact
# filename and match the version BASE (strip the trailing -<revision>) — exact
# and revision-agnostic. count stays empty on any query error → --republish fallback.
count=""
if json=$(curl -sSf -G "https://api.cloudsmith.io/v1/packages/$repo/" --data-urlencode "query=filename:bdinfo-rs-${{ matrix.triple }}.deb" --data-urlencode "page_size=100" 2>/dev/null); then
  count=$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq --arg v "$ver" '[.[] | select((.version | sub("-[0-9]+$"; "")) == $v)] | length' 2>/dev/null || true)
fi
if [ -n "$count" ] && [ "$count" != "0" ]; then
  echo "bdinfo-rs-${{ matrix.triple }}.deb ${ver} already in Cloudsmith (${count}) — skipping"
elif [ "$count" = "0" ]; then
  cloudsmith push deb "$repo/any-distro/any-version" "$file" \
    || { echo "plain push failed — retrying idempotently with --republish"; cloudsmith push deb --republish "$repo/any-distro/any-version" "$file"; }
else
  echo "could not query Cloudsmith state — pushing with --republish (safe)"
  cloudsmith push deb --republish "$repo/any-distro/any-version" "$file"
fi

steps.name: apt install bdinfo-rs from Cloudsmith (clean container) + check man/completions
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
docker run --rm ubuntu:latest bash -c '
  set -e
  apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates
  # Minimal Ubuntu images dpkg-exclude /usr/share/man/* to stay small;
  # drop that so the install is complete like a real system (the man page
  # IS in the .deb — the runner-based deb job already proves it installs).
  rm -f /etc/dpkg/dpkg.cfg.d/excludes
  for i in $(seq 1 12); do
    if curl -1sLf "https://dl.cloudsmith.io/public/bdinfo-rs/bdinfo-rs/setup.deb.sh" | bash \
       && apt-get install -y -qq bdinfo-rs; then ok=1; break; fi
    echo "waiting for the Cloudsmith index to propagate... ($i)"; sleep 10
  done
  [ -n "${ok:-}" ] || { echo "could not apt install bdinfo-rs from Cloudsmith"; exit 1; }
  bdinfo-rs --version
  ls /usr/share/man/man1/bdinfo-rs.1* >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "MISSING: man page"; exit 1; }

'

steps.name: Get version information ℹ️
steps.run:
set -eo pipefail

# Get dry-run mode
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
  DRY_RUN="${{ github.event.inputs.dry-run }}"
elif [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_call" ]; then
  DRY_RUN="${{ inputs.dry-run }}"
else
  DRY_RUN="false" # PR triggers are always production mode
fi

echo "Dry-run mode: $DRY_RUN"
echo "dry-run=$DRY_RUN" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

# Get version from inputs (for workflow_dispatch and workflow_call) or pubspec.yaml (for PR)
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
  RELEASE_VERSION="${{ github.event.inputs.increment }}"
elif [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_call" ]; then
  RELEASE_VERSION="${{ inputs.increment }}"
else
  RELEASE_VERSION=$(grep 'version: ' pubspec.yaml | sed -e 's,.*: \(.*\),\1,')
fi

# Determine release type based on PR labels or version format
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "pull_request" ]; then
  if [ "${{ contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci:prepare_release') }}" = "true" ]; then
    RELEASE_TYPE="standard"
    IS_PRERELEASE="false"
    echo "🚀 PR triggered standard release: $RELEASE_VERSION"
  elif [ "${{ contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci:ready_release_special') }}" = "true" ]; then
    RELEASE_TYPE="special"
    IS_PRERELEASE="true"
    echo "🔧 PR triggered special release: $RELEASE_VERSION"
  fi
else
  # Auto-detect release type based on version format for manual/callable triggers
  # Only clean semantic versions (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) are considered standard
  # Any version with suffix (pre-release, build metadata, etc.) is special
  if [[ $RELEASE_VERSION =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    # Clean semantic version: 6.5.0 (no suffix)
    RELEASE_TYPE="standard"
    IS_PRERELEASE="false"
    echo "🚀 Detected standard release version: $RELEASE_VERSION"
  else
    # Special version: any version with suffix
    # Examples: 2.2.6-beta.1, 2.2.6-rc.2, 2.2.6-sp.2262, 2.2.6+build.123
    RELEASE_TYPE="special"
    IS_PRERELEASE="true"
    echo "🔧 Detected special release version: $RELEASE_VERSION"
  fi
fi

echo "Release version: $RELEASE_VERSION"
echo "Release type: $RELEASE_TYPE" 
echo "Is prerelease: $IS_PRERELEASE"

echo "version=$RELEASE_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "release_type=$RELEASE_TYPE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "is_prerelease=$IS_PRERELEASE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "pull_request" ]; then
  if [ "${{ contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci:prepare_release') }}" = "true" ]; then
    RELEASE_TYPE="standard"

    RELEASE_TYPE="special"

  if [ "$FORCE_PUBLISH" = "true" ]; then

    if [[ $RELEASE_VERSION =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
      IS_PRERELEASE="false"

    fi
    echo "✅ Forced standard release: $RELEASE_VERSION"

    RELEASE_TYPE="special"
    IS_PRERELEASE="true"

  fi

service.description: Service to deploy (all, auth, image-processing, photo-management, cognito-backup)

steps.name: Install shared layer dependencies
steps.run:
cd common/layers/nodejs
npm i
cd ..
zip -r layer_content.zip nodejs
ls

# Publish the layer
LAYER_VERSION=$(aws lambda publish-layer-version \
  --layer-name SHARED_LAYER_${ENVIRONMENT} \
  --description "Shared Layer for Photo Blog App - ${ENVIRONMENT}" \
  --zip-file fileb://layer_content.zip \
  --compatible-runtimes nodejs20.x \
  --region $AWS_REGION \
  --output text \
  --query 'LayerVersionArn')
  
echo "Published layer version: $LAYER_VERSION"

# Store the layer ARN in SSM for reuse
aws ssm put-parameter \
  --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/shared-layer" \
  --value "$LAYER_VERSION" \
  --type "String" \
  --overwrite

# Store primary region in SSM for reuse
aws ssm put-parameter \
  --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/primary-region" \
  --value "${AWS_REGION}" \
  --type "String" \
  --overwrite

steps.name: Build and deploy root stack
steps.run:
sam build -t template.yaml
sam deploy \
  --stack-name photo-blog-app-${ENVIRONMENT} \
  --resolve-s3 \
  --parameter-overrides \
    Environment=${ENVIRONMENT} \
    DomainName=${DOMAIN_NAME} \
    PrimaryRegion=${AWS_REGION} \
    BackupRegion=${DR_REGION} \
  --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND \
  --no-fail-on-empty-changeset

steps.name: Export shared resources
steps.run:
# Get stack outputs and store in Parameter Store for cross-stack references
PROCESSED_BUCKET=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks \
  --stack-name photo-blog-app-${ENVIRONMENT} \
  --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='ProcessedImagesBucketName'].OutputValue" \
  --output text)

aws ssm put-parameter \
  --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/processed-bucket" \
  --value "${PROCESSED_BUCKET}" \
  --type "String" \
  --overwrite

steps.name: Build and deploy auth service
steps.run:
cd services/authentication
sam build -t template.yaml
sam deploy \
  --stack-name photo-blog-app-auth-${ENVIRONMENT} \
  --resolve-s3 \
  --parameter-overrides \
    Environment=${ENVIRONMENT} \
    DomainName=${DOMAIN_NAME} \
    SharedLayerArn=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/shared-layer" --query "Parameter.Value" --output text) \
  --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND \
  --no-fail-on-empty-changeset

steps.name: Export auth resources
steps.run:
USER_POOL_ID=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks \
  --stack-name photo-blog-app-auth-${ENVIRONMENT} \
  --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='UserPoolId'].OutputValue" \
  --output text)
  
USER_POOL_CLIENT=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks \
  --stack-name photo-blog-app-auth-${ENVIRONMENT} \
  --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='UserPoolClientId'].OutputValue" \
  --output text)
  
USER_POOL_ARN=$(aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool \
  --user-pool-id ${USER_POOL_ID} \
  --query "UserPool.Arn" \
  --output text)

USERS_TABLE=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks \
  --stack-name photo-blog-app-auth-${ENVIRONMENT} \
  --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='UsersTableName'].OutputValue" \
  --output text)
  
AUTH_API_ENDPOINT=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks \
  --stack-name photo-blog-app-auth-${ENVIRONMENT} \
  --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='ApiGatewayUrl'].OutputValue" \
  --output text)

aws ssm put-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/user-pool-id" --value "${USER_POOL_ID}" --type "String" --overwrite
aws ssm put-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/user-pool-client-id" --value "${USER_POOL_CLIENT}" --type "String" --overwrite
aws ssm put-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/user-pool-arn" --value "${USER_POOL_ARN}" --type "String" --overwrite
aws ssm put-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/users-table" --value "${USERS_TABLE}" --type "String" --overwrite
aws ssm put-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/auth-api-endpoint" --value "${AUTH_API_ENDPOINT}" --type "String" --overwrite

steps.name: Get Parameters from Primary Region
steps.run:
# Get the complete ARN instead of just the ID
PRIMARY_USER_POOL_ARN=$(aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool \
  --user-pool-id $(aws ssm get-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/user-pool-id" --query "Parameter.Value" --output text) \
  --query "UserPool.Arn" \
  --output text)
SHARED_LAYER_ARN=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/shared-layer" --query "Parameter.Value" --output text)

echo "PRIMARY_USER_POOL_ARN=${PRIMARY_USER_POOL_ARN}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
echo "SHARED_LAYER_ARN=${SHARED_LAYER_ARN}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

steps.name: Create shared layer in DR region
steps.run:
cd common/layers/nodejs
npm i
cd ..
zip -r layer_content.zip nodejs

# Publish the layer in DR region
DR_LAYER_VERSION=$(aws lambda publish-layer-version \
  --layer-name SHARED_LAYER_${ENVIRONMENT} \
  --description "Shared Layer for Photo Blog App - ${ENVIRONMENT}" \
  --zip-file fileb://layer_content.zip \
  --compatible-runtimes nodejs20.x \
  --region $DR_REGION \
  --output text \
  --query 'LayerVersionArn')
  
echo "Published DR layer version: $DR_LAYER_VERSION"
echo "DR_LAYER_ARN=${DR_LAYER_VERSION}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

steps.name: Build and deploy cognito backup service to DR region
steps.run:
cd dr/cognito
sam build -t template.yaml
sam deploy \
  --stack-name photo-blog-app-cognito-backup-${ENVIRONMENT} \
  --resolve-s3 \
  --parameter-overrides \
    Environment=${ENVIRONMENT} \
    DomainName=${DOMAIN_NAME} \
    SharedLayerArn=${DR_LAYER_ARN} \
    PrimaryRegion=${AWS_REGION} \
    PrimaryUserPoolArn=${PRIMARY_USER_POOL_ARN} \
  --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND \
  --no-fail-on-empty-changeset

steps.name: Get DR resources
steps.run:
DR_USER_POOL_ID=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks \
  --stack-name photo-blog-app-cognito-backup-${ENVIRONMENT} \
  --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='DRUserPoolId'].OutputValue" \
  --output text)
  
DR_USER_POOL_CLIENT_ID=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks \
  --stack-name photo-blog-app-cognito-backup-${ENVIRONMENT} \
  --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='DRUserPoolClientId'].OutputValue" \
  --output text)

echo "DR_USER_POOL_ID=${DR_USER_POOL_ID}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
echo "DR_USER_POOL_CLIENT_ID=${DR_USER_POOL_CLIENT_ID}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

steps.name: Switch back to Primary region and store parameters
Store DR resources in Primary region SSM
steps.run:
aws ssm put-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/dr-user-pool-id" --value "${DR_USER_POOL_ID}" --type "String" --overwrite
aws ssm put-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/dr-user-pool-client-id" --value "${DR_USER_POOL_CLIENT_ID}" --type "String" --overwrite

steps.name: Build and deploy image processing service
steps.run:
cd services/image-processing
sam build -t template.yaml
sam deploy \
  --stack-name photo-blog-app-image-processing-${ENVIRONMENT} \
  --resolve-s3 \
  --parameter-overrides \
    Environment=${ENVIRONMENT} \
    ProcessedBucketName=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/processed-bucket" --query "Parameter.Value" --output text) \
    SharedLayerArn=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/shared-layer" --query "Parameter.Value" --output text) \
  --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND \
  --no-fail-on-empty-changeset

steps.name: Export image processing resources
steps.run:
PHOTOS_TABLE=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks \
  --stack-name photo-blog-app-image-processing-${ENVIRONMENT} \
  --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='PhotosTableName'].OutputValue" \
  --output text)
  
STAGING_BUCKET=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks \
  --stack-name photo-blog-app-image-processing-${ENVIRONMENT} \
  --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='StagingBucketName'].OutputValue" \
  --output text)

# Configure DynamoDB Global Tables for DR
aws dynamodb update-table \
  --table-name ${PHOTOS_TABLE} \
  --replica-updates "Create={RegionName=${DR_REGION}}" \
  --billing-mode PAY_PER_REQUEST || echo "Global table already configured or failed to configure"

aws ssm put-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/photos-table" --value "${PHOTOS_TABLE}" --type "String" --overwrite
aws ssm put-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/staging-bucket" --value "${STAGING_BUCKET}" --type "String" --overwrite

steps.name: Build and deploy photo management service
steps.run:
cd services/photo-management
sam build -t template.yaml
sam deploy \
  --stack-name photo-blog-app-photo-management-${ENVIRONMENT} \
  --resolve-s3 \
  --parameter-overrides \
    Environment=${ENVIRONMENT} \
    ProcessedBucketName=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/processed-bucket" --query "Parameter.Value" --output text) \
    SharedLayerArn=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/shared-layer" --query "Parameter.Value" --output text) \
    PhotosTableName=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/photos-table" --query "Parameter.Value" --output text) \
    UserPoolArn=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/user-pool-arn" --query "Parameter.Value" --output text) \
  --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND \
  --no-fail-on-empty-changeset

steps.name: Export API Gateway endpoint
steps.run:
API_ENDPOINT=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks \
  --stack-name photo-blog-app-photo-management-${ENVIRONMENT} \
  --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='PhotosApiEndpoint'].OutputValue" \
  --output text)

aws ssm put-parameter \
  --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/api-endpoint" \
  --value "${API_ENDPOINT}" \
  --type "String" \
  --overwrite

steps.name: API Health Check
steps.run:
API_ENDPOINT=$(aws ssm get-parameter \
  --name "/photo-blog-app/${ENVIRONMENT}/api-endpoint" \
  --query "Parameter.Value" \
  --output text)

# Perform a basic health check
STATUS_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" ${API_ENDPOINT}/health || echo "000")

if [[ "$STATUS_CODE" == "200" ]]; then
  echo "API is healthy - Status code: $STATUS_CODE"
else
  echo "API health check failed - Status code: $STATUS_CODE"
  # Don't fail the pipeline, but log the issue
  aws cloudwatch put-metric-data \
    --namespace "PhotoBlogApp/${ENVIRONMENT}" \
    --metric-name "APIHealthCheckFailure" \
    --value 1 \
    --dimensions Service=PhotoManagement
fi

  version=$(echo "$release" | jq .app_version --raw-output)

  git add "Formula/${filename}"
  git commit -m "${name} ${version}"
done

steps.name: Bump versions for crates whose own files changed
steps.run:
# `--allow-dirty` below is intentional: each package update leaves
# its version/changelog edits for the final combined release commit.
# Fail here so it cannot mask changes that predate this loop.
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
  git status --short
  echo "Release checkout must start clean."
  exit 1
fi

members=$(sed -n '/^members = \[/,/^]/p' Cargo.toml | grep -oE '"[^"]+"' | tr -d '"')
for dir in $members; do
  grep -q '^publish *= *false' "$dir/Cargo.toml" && continue
  name=$(grep -m1 '^name *=' "$dir/Cargo.toml" | sed -E 's/.*"([^"]+)".*/\1/')
  ver=$(grep -m1 '^version *=' "$dir/Cargo.toml" | sed -E 's/.*"([^"]+)".*/\1/')
  # Exact-match this crate's tags: the glob "dynamo-parsers-v*" would
  # also match dynamo-parsers-v2-v0.1.21, so require <name>-v<semver>.
  last=$(git tag -l "$name-v*" | grep -E "^$name-v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$" | sort -V | tail -1)
  if [ -z "$last" ]; then
    echo "$name: no release tag yet -> first release is manual, skipping"
  elif [ "$ver" != "${last#"$name"-v}" ]; then
    echo "$name: $ver != last released ${last#"$name"-v} -> manually pegged"
    # A manual peg bypasses release-plz update — the only path that
    # runs cargo-semver-checks — so validate here that the pegged
    # jump is big enough for the actual API diff vs the last release.
    cargo semver-checks check-release --package "$name" --baseline-rev "$last"
    echo "$name: peg passes semver-checks, publish as-is"
  # The root Cargo.toml is part of every crate's change scope:
  # workspace-inherited dependency versions and [workspace.package]
  # metadata land in the published manifest of each member crate.
  elif git diff --quiet "$last"..HEAD -- "$dir" Cargo.toml; then
    echo "$name: no changes under $dir/ or the root Cargo.toml since $last"
  else
    echo "$name: changes under $dir/ (or root Cargo.toml) since $last -> auto-bump"
    release-plz update --allow-dirty -p "$name"
  fi
done

steps.name: Commit and push version bumps (if any)
steps.run:
if git diff --quiet; then
  echo "No version bumps proposed."
  exit 0
fi
# Informative subject listing every crate whose [package] version
# changed this run, e.g. "chore: release dynamo-protocols v1.4.0,
# dynamo-renderer v0.1.1". The name + literal version guard skips the
# workspace root. The "chore: release" prefix is mandatory — the
# recursion guard above keys off it.
git add -A
summary=$(for toml in $(git ls-files | grep -E '(^|/)Cargo\.toml$'); do
  name=$(grep -m1 '^name *=' "$toml" | sed -E 's/.*"([^"]+)".*/\1/')
  newver=$(grep -m1 '^version *=' "$toml" | sed -E 's/.*"([^"]+)".*/\1/')
  oldver=$(git show "HEAD:$toml" 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 '^version *=' | sed -E 's/.*"([^"]+)".*/\1/')
  if [ -n "$name" ] && [ -n "$newver" ] && [ "$newver" != "$oldver" ]; then
    printf '%s v%s, ' "$name" "$newver"
  fi
done | sed 's/, $//')
[ -z "$summary" ] && summary="version bumps"
git commit -s -m "chore: release $summary"
git push origin HEAD:main

steps.name: Checkout fork PR HEAD into sandboxed pr-content/ (DATA-ONLY)
Stage fork envelope for verifier (DATA-ONLY copy)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ "$IS_MERGE_GROUP" = "true" ]; then
  # merge_group: fetch the queue head SHA, then surface the
  # `.ai-sdlc/attestations` tree from it into our working tree.
  # Queue refs live in the same upstream repo so they're already
  # reachable after the main checkout's fetch-depth: 0; the
  # `git fetch origin <sha>` is a defensive belt-and-braces.
  git fetch --no-tags --depth=0 origin "$HEAD_SHA" 2>/dev/null \
    || git fetch --unshallow origin 2>/dev/null \
    || true
  git checkout "$HEAD_SHA" -- '.ai-sdlc/attestations' 2>/dev/null || true
  # AISDLC-383.4: also surface transcript-leaves.jsonl for v6 verifier.
  git checkout "$HEAD_SHA" -- '.ai-sdlc/transcript-leaves.jsonl' 2>/dev/null || true
  # AISDLC-445: also surface the per-patch-id transcript-leaves/ directory
  # (AISDLC-421 primary path). Without this, the verifier falls back to the
  # shared transcript-leaves.jsonl (which may contain stale leaves from a
  # prior PR), producing a misleading "rootSignature did not match" error
  # even when the envelope itself is valid.
  git checkout "$HEAD_SHA" -- '.ai-sdlc/transcript-leaves/' 2>/dev/null || true
  echo "[verify-attestation] merge_group: surfaced .ai-sdlc/attestations + transcript-leaves.jsonl + transcript-leaves/ from $HEAD_SHA (if present)"
else
  # pull_request_target: copy the envelope from the sandboxed
  # pr-content/ checkout. The sandbox MAY not have an envelope
  # (e.g. fork PR pushed without /ai-sdlc execute) — that's
  # expected; the verifier will report `no envelope present at
  # <sha>` and the status poster below will post FAILURE.
  mkdir -p .ai-sdlc/attestations
  STAGED=0
  # AISDLC-395 root-cause fix: copy EVERY envelope in pr-content/.ai-sdlc/attestations/
  # whose filename matches the strict <40hex>[.v6].dsse.json pattern, NOT just the
  # one named after $HEAD_SHA.
  #
  # The HEAD_SHA-only copy was the root cause of PR #616's apparent v4-kick:
  # when /ai-sdlc execute Step 10 signs an envelope on top of the dev commit
  # then adds it via a separate `chore: sign attestation` commit, the envelope
  # filename is the DEV commit's SHA (the sign target) — NOT the chore commit's
  # SHA (which is what GitHub reports as PR HEAD). The single-file copy silently
  # skipped it, the verifier walked only main's historical envelopes, and the
  # closest-match heuristic surfaced an irrelevant v4 mismatch.
  #
  # Filename validation (<40hex>[.v6].dsse.json) is the path-traversal guard —
  # a malicious fork PR cannot smuggle e.g. `../../etc/passwd.dsse.json` past
  # the regex. Signature verification by the downstream verifier remains the
  # trust boundary; bulk-copying overwrites is safe because envelopes are
  # content-addressed and any forged content would fail signature check.
  if [ -d "pr-content/.ai-sdlc/attestations" ]; then
    for envfile in pr-content/.ai-sdlc/attestations/*.dsse.json; do
      [ -f "$envfile" ] || continue
      basename="${envfile##*/}"
      # Strict pattern match: 40 lowercase hex + optional .v6 + .dsse.json.
      if [[ "$basename" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}(\.v6)?\.dsse\.json$ ]]; then
        cp -- "$envfile" ".ai-sdlc/attestations/$basename"
        STAGED=$((STAGED + 1))
      fi
    done
    echo "[verify-attestation] staged $STAGED envelope(s) from pr-content/"
  fi
  if [ "$STAGED" = "0" ]; then
    echo "[verify-attestation] no envelopes in pr-content/.ai-sdlc/attestations/ — verifier will report missing"
  fi
  # AISDLC-383.4: stage transcript-leaves.jsonl from fork PR content
  # for v6 Merkle verification. This is DATA-ONLY — the file is
  # read by the verifier (running from main's scripts/) as a JSON
  # record source; it is never executed or loaded as a script.
  if [ -f "pr-content/.ai-sdlc/transcript-leaves.jsonl" ]; then
    mkdir -p .ai-sdlc
    cp -- "pr-content/.ai-sdlc/transcript-leaves.jsonl" \
          ".ai-sdlc/transcript-leaves.jsonl"
    echo "[verify-attestation] staged transcript-leaves.jsonl from fork PR"
  fi
  # AISDLC-445:…

steps.name: Detect docs-only changeset
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# -c core.quotePath=false emits raw UTF-8 filenames instead of C-quoted
# form so non-ASCII paths match the DOCS_ONLY_PATTERN correctly
# (AISDLC-205 round 3 fix — preserved from the retired fallback workflow).
FILES=$(git -c core.quotePath=false diff --name-only "${BASE_SHA}...${HEAD_SHA}")
if [ -z "${FILES}" ]; then
  echo "No changed files in changeset; treating as docs-only (nothing to attest)"
  echo "all_docs=true" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
else
  ALL_DOCS=$(printf '%s\n' "${FILES}" | node scripts/is-docs-only-changeset.mjs)
  echo "all_docs=${ALL_DOCS}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
  echo "Docs-only detection result: ${ALL_DOCS}"
  echo "Files: $(printf '%s\n' "${FILES}" | head -20 | sed 's/^/  - /')"
fi

  -f description='docs-only changeset — attestation N/A'

steps.name: Detect release-please PR
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
IS_RP='false'

# Trust signal: the `release-please--` branch-name prefix +
# a fork-source guard (same-repo only).
#
# We previously gated on BOTH the prefix AND a bot-identity allowlist
# (github-actions[bot] / release-please[bot] / app/github-actions).
# That broke the moment release-please-action started pushing under
# `secrets.AI_SDLC_PAT` (PR #450) — the resulting PR's `user.login`
# is the operator's identity (e.g. `deefactorial`), NOT a bot. Every
# legit release-please PR fell through to full verification and
# posted `contentHashV4 mismatch`.
#
# For SAME-REPO PRs, the prefix-only trust is sufficient — the
# `auto-enable-auto-merge.yml` release-please skip (PR #445) means
# release-please PRs do NOT auto-merge: the operator MUST manually
# arm `gh pr merge <N> --auto` to ship one. That human-in-the-loop
# is the trust gate for prefix bypasses by same-repo pushers.
#
# AISDLC-381 (pull_request_target migration) introduced a NEW attack
# vector: a malicious FORK PR with branch `release-please--evil`
# would otherwise match this prefix and post
# `ai-sdlc/attestation: success` on the fork's HEAD SHA — fully
# bypassing the DSSE attestation gate. The operator-trust argument
# above DOES NOT cover fork PRs because the malicious code is
# already in the PR diff at the moment the workflow fires + posts
# the success status; an operator could miss the prefix bypass
# entirely until merge. The fix is the fork-source guard below:
# only honor the prefix when PR_HEAD_REPO_FULL == REPO. Fork PRs
# with this prefix fall through to the full verifier which will
# correctly report `no envelope` or `invalid` → status:failure.
#
# Net: branch-prefix + fork-source guard matches the actual model.
# See PR #455 for the original rationale + PR #X (AISDLC-381 iter-2)
# for the fork-source guard addition.

# pull_request: branch prefix is sufficient — BUT the prefix
# is only trustworthy when the PR comes from the SAME repo
# (not a fork). Under pull_request_target a fork PR with branch
# name `release-please--evil` would otherwise bypass the
# attestation verifier entirely and post `ai-sdlc/attestation:
# success` on a malicious head SHA. The fork-source guard
# below restricts the short-circuit to same-repo PRs only;
# any release-please-named branch from a fork falls through
# to the full envelope verifier path (which will report
# missing/invalid → status:failure). AISDLC-381 iter-2 CRITICAL.
case "${PR_HEAD_REF:-}" in
  release-please--*)
    if [ "${PR_HEAD_REPO_FULL:-}" = "${REPO}" ]; then
      IS_RP='true'
      echo "pull_request release-please match: head_ref='${PR_HEAD_REF}' head_repo='${PR_HEAD_REPO_FULL}' (same-repo trust)"
    else
      echo "pull_request release-please prefix on FORK PR ('${PR_HEAD_REPO_FULL}' != '${REPO}') — NOT trusting prefix; falling through to full verification"
    fi
    ;;
esac

# merge_group: parse PR number from queue branch, look up source
# PR's head_ref. Allow multi-segment protected branch names
# (e.g. `release/1.0`) — the queue branch is
# `gh-readonly-queue/<base>/pr-<N>-<sha>`. GitHub passes the
# merge_group head_ref WITH a `refs/heads/` prefix (witnessed in
# workflow logs as `refs/heads/gh-readonly-queue/...`), so the
# regex makes the prefix optional.
if [ "$IS_RP" = 'false' ] && [ -n "${MERGE_GROUP_HEAD_REF:-}" ]; then
  PR_NUM=$(printf '%s' "$MERGE_GROUP_HEAD_REF" | sed -nE 's|^(refs/heads/)?gh-readonly-queue/.*/pr-([0-9]+)-[^/]*$|\2|p')
  if [ -n "$PR_NUM" ]; then
    # No `|| echo ''` — we want gh failure to fail the step loud.
    if SOURCE_HEAD_REF=$(gh pr view "$PR_NUM" --repo "$REPO" --json headRefName --jq '.headRefName'); then
      case "$SOURCE_HEAD_REF" in
        release-please--*)
          IS_RP='true'
          echo "merge_group release-please match: PR=#${PR_NUM}, headRefName='${SOURCE_HEAD_REF}'"
          ;;

set -euo pipefail
gh api "repos/${REPO}/statuses/${HEAD_SHA}" \
  -X POST \
  -f state=success \
  -f context='ai-sdlc/attestation' \
  -f description='release-please version bump — attestation N/A'
echo "Posted ai-sdlc/attestation: success (release-please short-circuit) on ${HEAD_SHA}"

steps.name: Install (orchestrator only — verifier needs the runtime barrel)
Build orchestrator + dependencies (verifier imports compiled JS)
Fetch signedMergeBase if unreachable (v5 rebase-stability fix)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
ATTDIR=".ai-sdlc/attestations"
if [ ! -d "$ATTDIR" ]; then
  echo "[fetch-signedMergeBase] no attestations dir — skipping"
  exit 0
fi
for env_file in "$ATTDIR"/*.dsse.json; do
  [ -f "$env_file" ] || continue
  # Extract signedMergeBase from the decoded payload (jq + base64).
  SMB=$(node -e "
    const {readFileSync} = require('fs');
    const env = JSON.parse(readFileSync('${env_file}', 'utf-8'));
    if (!env.payload) process.exit(0);
    const pred = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(env.payload, 'base64').toString('utf-8'));
    if (pred.signedMergeBase && /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(pred.signedMergeBase)) {
      process.stdout.write(pred.signedMergeBase + '\n');
    }
  " 2>/dev/null || true)
  [ -z "$SMB" ] && continue
  # Check reachability.
  if git cat-file -t "$SMB" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "[fetch-signedMergeBase] $SMB is reachable — no fetch needed"
  else
    echo "[fetch-signedMergeBase] $SMB unreachable — fetching from origin..."
    git fetch --depth=1 origin "$SMB" 2>/dev/null \
      || git fetch --unshallow origin 2>/dev/null \
      || echo "[fetch-signedMergeBase] WARN: could not fetch $SMB — verifier will fall back to v4"
  fi
done

steps.name: Post ai-sdlc/attestation status
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ "$STATUS" = "valid" ]; then
  STATE=success
  # Surface the verifier's reason in the success description so
  # soft-fail / spot-check qualifiers ("soft-fail: …") are visible
  # on the GitHub status surface, not just buried in workflow logs.
  # Per AISDLC-383.4 security review: a hardcoded clean string
  # would mask the soft-fail caveat from operators reviewing PR
  # status. Truncate to 130 chars (GitHub limit is 140) with
  # a sensible default when the reason is empty.
  DESC="${REASON:0:130}"
  if [ -z "${DESC:-}" ]; then
    DESC="valid envelope at HEAD"
  fi
  echo "::notice::ai-sdlc attestation valid on $HEAD_SHA: $REASON"
elif [ -z "${STATUS:-}" ]; then
  # Verifier crashed before emitting status= to GITHUB_OUTPUT.
  STATE=failure
  DESC="verifier crashed before emitting result — see workflow logs"
  echo "::error::ai-sdlc attestation verifier crashed on $HEAD_SHA"
else
  STATE=failure
  # GitHub status descriptions are truncated at 140 chars; trim.
  DESC="${REASON:0:130}"
  echo "::warning::ai-sdlc attestation $STATUS on $HEAD_SHA: $REASON"
fi
gh api "repos/${REPO}/statuses/${HEAD_SHA}" \
  -X POST \
  -f state="$STATE" \
  -f context='ai-sdlc/attestation' \
  -f description="$DESC" \
  ${PR_URL:+-f target_url="$PR_URL"}
echo "Posted ai-sdlc/attestation: $STATE on $HEAD_SHA"

    # macOS (arm64)

    # Windows (amd64)

    # Windows (386)

    os="${parts[0]}"
    arch="${parts[1]}"
    suffix="${parts[2]}"
    display_os="${parts[3]}"

    # 构建目标目录

    mkdir -p "$target_dir"
    # 使用 xgo 构建

        --targets="$os/$arch" \
        --out "krillinai_desktop" \
        --dest "$target_dir" \

done

# Kill the dev server

  # On Windows, kill by port is more reliable than DEV_PID
  # because bash's $! may not map to the actual Windows process ID
  DEV_PORT=3000

  done

steps.run:
AWS_REGION="${{ secrets.AWS_REGION }}"; AWS_REGION="${AWS_REGION:-eu-west-2}"; export AWS_REGION
echo "Getting stack outputs..."
aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name lockbox-box-service --region "$AWS_REGION" --query "Stacks[0].Outputs" --output table || true
API_AFTER=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name lockbox-box-service --region "$AWS_REGION" --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='ApiURL'].OutputValue" --output text || true)

if [ -n "${{ steps.before.outputs.userpool_before }}" ] && [ "${{ steps.before.outputs.userpool_before }}" != "$USERPOOL_AFTER" ]; then
  echo "::error::Cognito User Pool changed from '${{ steps.before.outputs.userpool_before }}' to '$USERPOOL_AFTER'. Aborting." && exit 1

steps.run:
# Update root module replacements
go mod edit -replace github.com/charmbracelet/crush=./crush-plugin-poc
go mod edit -replace github.com/aleksclark/crush-modules/agent-status=./agent-status
go mod edit -replace github.com/aleksclark/crush-modules/acp=./acp
go mod edit -replace github.com/aleksclark/crush-modules/otlp=./otlp
go mod edit -replace github.com/aleksclark/crush-modules/periodic-prompts=./periodic-prompts
go mod edit -replace github.com/aleksclark/crush-modules/subagents=./subagents
go mod edit -replace github.com/aleksclark/crush-modules/tempotown=./tempotown
go mod edit -replace github.com/aleksclark/crush-modules/tavily=./tavily
go mod edit -replace github.com/aleksclark/crush-modules/kuri=./kuri
go mod edit -replace github.com/aleksclark/crush-modules/a2a=./a2a

# Propagate replace directives from crush-plugin-poc's go.mod
while IFS= read -r line; do
  if [[ "$line" =~ ^replace\ (.+)\ =\>\ (.+)$ ]]; then
    mod="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    target="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    [[ "$mod" == "github.com/charmbracelet/crush" ]] && continue
    # Convert "path version" to "path@version" for go mod edit
    target="${target/ /@}"
    go mod edit -replace "${mod}=${target}"
  fi
done < crush-plugin-poc/go.mod

# Update plugin module replacements
for mod in acp a2a otlp agent-status periodic-prompts subagents tempotown tavily kuri; do
  cd $mod
  go mod edit -replace github.com/charmbracelet/crush=../crush-plugin-poc
  go mod edit -replace github.com/aleksclark/crush-modules=../
  cd ..
done

steps.name: Check DCO sign-off
steps.run:
failed=0
while IFS= read -r sha; do
  message=$(git log -1 --format='%B' "$sha")
  if ! echo "$message" | grep -qP '^Signed-off-by: .+ <.+>'; then
    echo "::error::Commit $sha is missing a valid 'Signed-off-by' trailer"
    echo "---"
    echo "$message"
    echo "---"
    failed=1
  fi
done < <(git rev-list "$BASE_SHA".."$HEAD_SHA")

if [ "$failed" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo ""
  echo "All commits must include a 'Signed-off-by' line."
  echo "Use 'git commit -s' to add it automatically."
  echo "See CONTRIBUTING.md for details."
  exit 1
fi

echo "All commits have valid DCO sign-off."

steps.name: Resolve version
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then
  v="$INPUT_VERSION"
else
  # Release runs are tag-pushed; head_branch carries the tag name.
  v="$RUN_HEAD_BRANCH"
fi
if [[ -z "$v" ]]; then
  echo "::error::Could not determine smoke-test version"
  exit 1
fi
# Reject anything that does not match the release tag pattern from
# release.yaml so an accidentally-dispatched branch name cannot drive
# a smoke test.
if ! [[ "$v" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::Refusing to smoke-test non-release version: '$v'"
  exit 1
fi
echo "version=$v" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "Smoke testing version: $v"

steps.name: Wait for Maven Central propagation
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
artifacts=(
  "jna"
  "regex"
  "pcre4j-native-${NATIVE_PLATFORM}"
)
deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + 1800 ))
attempt=0
while true; do
  attempt=$((attempt + 1))
  missing=""
  for artifact in "${artifacts[@]}"; do
    url="https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/pcre4j/${artifact}/${PCRE4J_VERSION}/${artifact}-${PCRE4J_VERSION}.jar"
    if ! curl -fsSI "$url" -o /dev/null; then
      missing="$artifact"
      break
    fi
  done
  if [[ -z "$missing" ]]; then
    echo "All artifacts visible after attempt $attempt"
    exit 0
  fi
  if (( $(date +%s) >= deadline )); then
    echo "::error::Artifacts not visible on Maven Central after 30 minutes (last missing: ${missing}-${PCRE4J_VERSION}.jar)"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "Attempt ${attempt}: ${missing}-${PCRE4J_VERSION}.jar not yet visible, sleeping 30s..."
  sleep 30
done

steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
sed \
  -e "s/@VERSION@/${PCRE4J_VERSION}/g" \

  pom.xml.template > pom.xml
echo "--- rendered pom.xml ---"
cat pom.xml

steps.name: Resolve dependencies from Maven Central
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mvn -B -ntp -q dependency:build-classpath -Dmdep.outputFile=cp.txt
# Sanity: the resolved classpath must include the native bundle.
if ! grep -q "pcre4j-native-${NATIVE_PLATFORM}-${PCRE4J_VERSION}\.jar" cp.txt; then
  echo "::error::Resolved classpath does not include pcre4j-native-${NATIVE_PLATFORM}-${PCRE4J_VERSION}.jar"
  cat cp.txt
  exit 1
fi
echo "Classpath includes the native bundle"

steps.name: Compile smoke test
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p build
javac -cp "$(cat cp.txt)" -d build SmokeTest.java

steps.name: Run smoke test (no pcre2.library.path; system discovery disabled)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Windows runners with shell:bash still need ';' for Java classpath.
if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == "Windows" ]]; then
  sep=";"
else
  sep=":"
fi
cp_str=$(cat cp.txt)
# Explicitly DO NOT pass: -Dpcre2.library.path, -Djna.library.path,
# -Djava.library.path. AND disable Pcre2LibraryFinder so a
# system-installed pcre2 cannot mask an empty bundle on macOS or Linux.
# shellcheck disable=SC2016  # %4$s/%5$s are SimpleFormatter placeholders, not shell vars
java \
  -Dpcre2.library.discovery=false \
  -Djava.util.logging.SimpleFormatter.format='%4$s: %5$s%n' \
  -cp "build${sep}${cp_str}" \
  SmokeTest

  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Bump Version
steps.run:
echo "----------------------------------------------------------------"
echo "Bumping version with type: ${{ github.event.inputs.bump }}"
./dev-ops/bump-version.sh ${{ github.event.inputs.bump }}
NEW_VERSION=$(mvn help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.version -q -DforceStdout)
echo "version=$NEW_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "Bumped version to $NEW_VERSION"

steps.name: Create Release Branch
steps.run:
echo "----------------------------------------------------------------"
RELEASE_VERSION="${{ steps.bump-version.outputs.version }}"
BRANCH_NAME="release/v$RELEASE_VERSION"

echo "Preparing release branch '$BRANCH_NAME' (replay-friendly mode)"

# Track whether we stashed local changes
STASHED=false

# Attempt to stash any local changes (including untracked) so checkouts won't fail.
# This is necessary because previous steps (bump-version) can modify files.
echo "Attempting to stash local changes (if any)"
STASH_NAME="release-bump-$RELEASE_VERSION-$(date +%s)"
STASH_OUTPUT=$(git stash push -u -m "$STASH_NAME" 2>&1 || true)
echo "stash output: $STASH_OUTPUT"
if ! echo "$STASH_OUTPUT" | grep -q "No local changes to save"; then
  STASHED=true
  echo "Stash created: $STASH_NAME"
else
  echo "No local changes to stash"
fi

# If remote branch exists, fetch and reuse it
if git ls-remote --heads origin "$BRANCH_NAME" | grep -q "refs/heads/$BRANCH_NAME"; then
  echo "Remote branch exists; fetching and reusing $BRANCH_NAME"
  git fetch origin "$BRANCH_NAME":"$BRANCH_NAME"
  git checkout "$BRANCH_NAME"
fi

# If local branch exists, check it out
if git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/"$BRANCH_NAME"; then
  echo "Local branch exists; checking out $BRANCH_NAME"
  git checkout "$BRANCH_NAME"
else
  # Create the branch locally if it hasn't been created or checked out above
  if [ "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)" != "$BRANCH_NAME" ]; then
    git checkout -b "$BRANCH_NAME"
  fi
fi

# If we stashed earlier, reapply the stash onto the release branch
if [ "$STASHED" = "true" ]; then
  echo "Applying previously saved stash onto $BRANCH_NAME"
  if ! git stash pop; then
    echo "Failed to apply stash cleanly. Resolve conflicts manually." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# Configure committer
git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"

# Stage and commit only if there are changes
git add pom.xml
if git diff --staged --quiet; then
  echo "No staged changes to commit on $BRANCH_NAME"
else
  git commit -m "chore: bump version to $RELEASE_VERSION for release"
fi

# Push branch with --force-with-lease to allow updating existing branches during replays
git push origin "$BRANCH_NAME" --force-with-lease
echo "Created or updated release branch: $BRANCH_NAME"

steps.name: Build and Test (Jar)
steps.run:

echo "Building project (includes tests)"
mvn -B -ntp clean verify
ls -lh target/*.jar || true

steps.name: Publish to GitHub Packages
steps.run:
echo "----------------------------------------------------------------"
echo "Publishing version ${{ steps.bump-version.outputs.version }} to GitHub Packages"
set +e
mvn -B -ntp deploy -DskipTests 2>&1 | tee /tmp/deploy-output.txt
DEPLOY_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
set -e
if [ $DEPLOY_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
  if grep -q "status code: 409" /tmp/deploy-output.txt; then
    echo "Version ${{ steps.bump-version.outputs.version }} already exists in GitHub Packages (409 Conflict) — skipping."
  else
    echo "Deploy failed with an unexpected error (exit $DEPLOY_EXIT)"
    exit $DEPLOY_EXIT
  fi
else
  echo "Successfully published version ${{ steps.bump-version.outputs.version }}"
fi

steps.name: Release with JReleaser
steps.run:
echo "----------------------------------------------------------------"
echo "Releasing version: ${{ steps.bump-version.outputs.version }}"
echo "Running JReleaser full release"
mvn -B -ntp jreleaser:full-release \
  -Djreleaser.config.file=jreleaser.yml

steps.name: Create PR and merge release branch to main
steps.run:
echo "----------------------------------------------------------------"
RELEASE_VERSION="${{ steps.bump-version.outputs.version }}"
BRANCH_NAME="release/v$RELEASE_VERSION"
echo "Creating PR to merge $BRANCH_NAME into main"

# Create PR (idempotent: won't fail if PR already exists)
gh pr create \
  --base main \
  --head "$BRANCH_NAME" \
  --title "chore: release v$RELEASE_VERSION" \
  --body "Automated release merge for v$RELEASE_VERSION" || echo "PR may already exist, continuing..."

# --admin bypasses branch protection rules (required reviews).
# Requires GH_TOKEN to belong to a repository admin.
gh pr merge "$BRANCH_NAME" \
  --admin \
  --squash \
  --subject "chore: release v$RELEASE_VERSION" \
  --body "Automated release merge for v$RELEASE_VERSION" \
  --delete-branch

echo "Successfully merged $BRANCH_NAME into main"

steps.name: Analyze commits and calculate next version
steps.run:
LAST_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 origin/master 2>/dev/null || echo "")
if [ -z "$LAST_TAG" ]; then
  echo "has_release=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi

CURRENT=${LAST_TAG#v}
echo "current_version=$CURRENT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

IFS='.' read -r MAJOR MINOR PATCH <<< "$CURRENT"

BUMP=""
while IFS= read -r msg; do
  if echo "$msg" | grep -qi 'BREAKING CHANGE'; then
    BUMP="major"
    break
  fi

  TYPE=$(echo "$msg" | grep -oE '^[a-z]+[\(:]' | sed 's/[(:]//' || true)
  case "$TYPE" in
    feat)
      [ "$BUMP" != "major" ] && BUMP="minor"
      ;;
    fix|perf|refactor|revert)
      [ -z "$BUMP" ] && BUMP="patch"
      ;;
  esac
done < <(git log --format="%s%n%b" "$LAST_TAG"..HEAD)

if [ -n "$BUMP" ]; then
  case "$BUMP" in
    major) NEXT="$((MAJOR + 1)).0.0" ;;
    minor) NEXT="$MAJOR.$((MINOR + 1)).0" ;;
    patch) NEXT="$MAJOR.$MINOR.$((PATCH + 1))" ;;
  esac
  echo "next_version=$NEXT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "has_release=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "has_release=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Sync uv.lock to package version
steps.run:
python - <<'PY' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
import re
import tomllib
from pathlib import Path

version = tomllib.loads(
    Path("pyproject.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
)["project"]["version"]

lock_path = Path("uv.lock")
text = lock_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

# Update only the editable neuralspotx package version. This keeps the
# lockfile in sync with pyproject.toml without sweeping in unrelated
# transitive dependency updates that a full `uv lock` would pull in.
pattern = re.compile(
    r'(\[\[package\]\]\nname = "neuralspotx"\nversion = ")[^"]*(")'
)
if not pattern.search(text):
    raise SystemExit(
        "Could not locate editable neuralspotx package block in uv.lock."
    )

updated = pattern.sub(rf"\g<1>{version}\g<2>", text, count=1)
lock_path.write_text(updated, encoding="utf-8")

print(f"version={version}")
PY

steps.name: Publish workspace crates
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

# In dep order — each crate's deps must be on crates.io first.
CRATES=(
  starla-common
  starla-network
  starla-controller
  starla-metrics
  starla-measurements
  starla-results
  starla-scheduler
  starla
  starla-tray
)
VER="${VERSION#v}"

# crates.io 403s anonymous requests without a User-Agent.
UA="starla-release-check (https://github.com/ananthb/starla)"

version_published() {
  local name=$1
  local code
  code=$(curl -sS -A "$UA" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
    "https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/${name}/${VER}")
  [[ "$code" == "200" ]]
}

crate_exists() {
  local name=$1
  local code
  code=$(curl -sS -A "$UA" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
    "https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/${name}")
  [[ "$code" == "200" ]]
}

# Filter out crates whose current version is already on crates.io.
pending=()
for crate in "${CRATES[@]}"; do
  if version_published "$crate"; then
    echo "✓ ${crate} ${VER} already published — skipping"
  else
    pending+=("$crate")
  fi
done

if [[ ${#pending[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "All workspace crates already published at ${VER}."
  exit 0
fi

is_new=()
for crate in "${pending[@]}"; do
  if crate_exists "$crate"; then
    is_new+=("false")
  else
    is_new+=("true")
  fi
done

for i in "${!pending[@]}"; do
  crate="${pending[$i]}"
  if [[ $i -gt 0 && "${is_new[$i]}" == "true" && "${is_new[$((i-1))]}" == "true" ]]; then
    echo "Sleeping 605s before next new-crate publish (rate limit)"
    sleep 605
  fi
  echo "→ Publishing ${crate}"
  nix develop -c cargo publish -p "$crate"
done
